rule.title: Comprehensive TSDoc on Public Services and Interfaces
rule.statement: All exported services, utilities, and API client methods must have formal TSDoc comments with @param, @returns, and @throws tags.
rule.rationale: Standardized TSDoc enables IDE hover documentation, auto-completion descriptions, and automated documentation generation for team members.
rule.implementation_guidance: Provide summary description, parameter explanations, expected return values, and documented exceptions.

forbidden.example: export function chunk(text) { ... } // Exported with zero TSDoc metadata

source.evidence_quote: Document the interfaces, not the implementation. Good API documentation describes pre-conditions, post-conditions, parameters, and failure modes.
